summary: One-year wood-fire specialist residency starting in September with option to renew up to 3 years. Requires prior wood-kiln firing experience and involves maintaining winter/spring anagama and multiple train firings per year.
commitment: 1 year, renewable up to 3 years, starting September
evidence_sentence: Wood-fire residents participate in winter and spring anagama firings and several train firings annually.
evidence_quote: The Cobb Mountain Art & Ecology Project wood-fire program consist of Winter & Spring Anagama firings and several train firings per year.
pay_text: Monthly rent with work-exchange options available; artists pay own material and firing expenses
